input.request: Maren’s debit card had become unreliable, so she submitted a replacement request. She contacted H&V to find out whether the card was being made and whether it had been sent.

events.text: I submitted a replacement request because my card has become unreliable. Could you check whether it is being made and whether it has been sent?
I’ve completed H&V’s identity checks in this secure chat. I’ll check the existing replacement record and won’t make any changes to your account.
I checked the card journal for reference HV-030. The record shows the replacement is in manufacture; it does not confirm dispatch or delivery.

summary: Maren Ellery, a verified customer on secure chat, asked whether her replacement card is being made and whether it has been sent. The desk checked the card journal, which shows the replacement is in manufacture but does not confirm dispatch or delivery, and it closed the case as "wait" because the card system's answer was not yet in. A second request to the card system was refused because the case was already in the waiting state, and no changes were made to her account. Nothing has been sent to Maren about the card's status, so the case stays open until the card system's answer arrives or a person picks it up.

- request_type (choice): What does the customer want from the bank now?
    status: the stage or status of a payment, card, file, device or request

    document: a statement, an export, a report or a confirmation made available in the portal
    access: signing in, a PIN, a password, recovery of access
    authority: something only another person may approve or give (a second signatory, an administrator, a new user's access)
    unknown: The text does not say, or says too little to tell.
- subject (choice): What is the request about?
    transfer: an outgoing transfer or payment the customer made, or a payment instruction
    incoming_payment: money expected into the customer's account, or a refund to it

    card: a card itself (replacement, dispatch, block, restriction, PIN)
    card_payment: a card purchase or card payment attempt
    batch: an uploaded payment or payroll file, or a row in it
    payment_package: a payment package waiting for signatories
    profile: the customer's profile details (name, phone, address)
    access: signing in, devices, sessions, password recovery
    statement: an account statement
    document: an export, a report or a bank confirmation document

About this desk:
A bank's service desk (Harrow & Vale Bank, fictional). The bank never acts or approves for someone else, never handles a PIN or a password, and never claims more than a record shows.

The case stops at one moment: choose the bank's next step from here with one tool, then stop. The facts are what the desk read from the bank's records; a fact not listed is not known yet. I haven't taken a further step on this case. It is in a final WAITING state, and the desk refused my second request to the card system.
